icons: Each sphere and workshop page appears as an icon generated from its own source: pal = its most frequent CSS colours, bg = its darkest colour, a ring per canvas, a spoke per script block, a centre dot for SVG, a wavy ring for sound, and spin if it animates. The icon links directly to the original page (spheres["h"], workshop["page"]); there is no page in between.

emergent.world: 0-spheres are agents with 2 dots (0), 2 vectors (−1) and 2 edges (+1). A free vector port seeks the nearest free edge port of a neighbour; meeting forms a bond (−1 joined to +1 = 0). Bonds break under stretch or heat. Bonding cools the world (homeostasis). New 0-spheres arrive at a logistic rate r·(1−N/K). A bonded cluster of KT = clamp(round(K/24), 7, 9) becomes a keeper (an attractor, named in order of emergence). Every 8 bonds in a keeper's cluster opens a domain (up to 64). Seeded with mulberry32 (?seed=). Self-check: each 0-sphere, each bond and the world total must be 0, or the page throws.
emergent.keeper: the keeper sits at the centre, and its 64 domain icons orbit and flock by palette similarity
emergent.domain: icons of the domain's pages flock by palette similarity; tap one to open the original
emergent.zero_sphere: six charges under pairwise Coulomb-like forces with a hard core and damping; seed = sha256(page path); net charge is recomputed every frame

groups.rule: 88 = 42 sapphons × 4 members + 45 ions × 3 members + 1 (SaPpH{{i}}on, the center). 304 member slots. All pages are ordered by their icon palette (dominant colour: chroma, hue, lightness) and cut into 303 contiguous bundles of neighbouring pages; each bundle is one member. The first 168 bundles form the sapphons and the next 135 form the ions. The center's single member is the world page and the cube door.
